title: Restore Reveal.js Presentation Product Framework
description: Restore the old reveal.js-based presentation product framework from git history (latest version), place it under 🧰️framework/🛍️products/🎤️presentation, port it to the new repo architecture, and get the mit-bestand 33.projektetage presentation compiling to a clean presentation.
summary: Restored the reveal.js-based presentation product under 🧰️framework/🛍️products/🎤️presentation from its latest git descendant (the animate plugin's declarative core and React + reveal.js renderer, which grew out of the July framework/product/presentation tree). New packages @semio-tech/presentation (render-independent core, 56 tests) and @semio-tech/presentation-react (renderer target with 🎨️.css, markdown and pdf modules, 147 tests), a language-agnostic markdown-to-HTML case validated against the unified/remark stack with oracle registry, README with the domain model, products manifest member, root workspaces/scripts and launch entries. The 33. Projektetage consumer was repointed to the product, renamed to the canonical 🌐️.html/🟦️.ts entries, and its deck spec split into 🔖️spec.ts to break a top-level-await import cycle that blanked the page; the styling module's recursive cpSync was replaced by an owned copier because Node 24 hard-crashes on emoji source paths. Verified: package router build exits 0 with a complete dist, 28 projektetage tests pass, and the dev server renders the deck (39 sections, title, Recherche and Bauteilportal slides, no console errors). Not restored: the July Rust deck crate and playground host, which depended on deleted products.
